This code combined the Standard Element 1 (Data acquisition) and Standard Element 2 (Data processing) for the soil plant available phosphorus dataset from Mcdowell et al. 2023.

Reference: McDowell, R.W., Noble, A., Pletnyakov, P. et al. A Global Database of Soil Plant Available Phosphorus. Sci Data 10, 125 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02022-4

Since soil plant available phosphorus does not change much through out the year, we will use value from the averaged year for all the years from 1992 to 2020.

First you need to download the OlsenP_5arcmin_mgkg.tif file from Figshare. This is the link: https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Global_Available_Soil_Phosphorus_Database/14241854


Call the library, get the file, duplicate to 29 layers
```{r}
library(terra)

# Input single-layer raster
OlsenP_single <- rast("OlsenP_5arcmin_mgkg.tif")

# Duplicate to 29 layers (1992-2020)
OlsenP_stack <- rast(replicate(29, OlsenP_single, simplify = FALSE))

# Name layers y1992 ... y2020
names(OlsenP_stack) <- paste0("y", 1992:2020)

# Save stack
writeRaster(
  OlsenP_stack,
  "OlsenP_5arcmin_stack_mgkg.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

OlsenP_stack
plot(OlsenP_stack)
```
